channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jim Boylen | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jim Boylen from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Jim Boylen
item.description:
“She’s done a great job this year with our defensive stuff. Her and Jim Boylen really collaborate on a lot of that stuff,”

Rick Carlisle on Jim Boylen, Jun 8, 2025. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Daniel Gafford on Jim Boylen
item.description:
“As a matter of fact, I will read it out. Do you like Jim Boylen? He aight. I don’t like him a lot, but he OK.Got some things he can work on, got some things he can get better at as a person and as a coach. I’m not going to hate on him. I’m not going to hate the man.”

Daniel Gafford on Jim Boylen, Jul 20, 2020. Source: WSCR 670 AM.

item.title: Thaddeus Young on Jim Boylen
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thad Young on Jim Boylen:

“That's up to the front office. Obviously, Jim is probably one of the most energetic coaches I've ever played for. My job is to play hard and try to lead this team.”

Thaddeus Young on Jim Boylen, Jun 5, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Lauri Markkanen on Jim Boylen
item.description:
When asked about his lack of involvement in the offense this season, Markkanen told Seppänen

“I had 80 touches per game the past two seasons, this season the touches dropped to 40. Don’t get me wrong, I had some plays drawn with me in mind, but it’s just different. When I spoke with Jim [Boylen], we talked about how I should concentrate on getting rebounds and then leading the fast break. But it’s just really hard getting 40 defensive rebounds.”

Lauri Markkanen on Jim Boylen, May 26, 2020. Source: OnTapSportsnet.com.

item.title: Marc Eversley on Jim Boylen
item.description:
KC Johnson:Eversley on Boylen:

“We're going to utilize our time to evaluate everybody on our staff, both players and coaches.”

Marc Eversley on Jim Boylen, May 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Wendell Carter Jr on Jim Boylen
item.description:
Cody Westerlund:Wendell Carter Jr. on Jim Boylen:

“Especially with a coach like Jim, he's going to push us. I feel like we all respond pretty well when he pushes us.”

Wendell Carter Jr on Jim Boylen, Mar 7, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kris Dunn on Jim Boylen
item.description:
Kris Dunn, on his conversation with Jim Boylen about coming off bench:

“I just appreciate Coach talking to me and being straightforward and being truthful to me. I’m going to do my job and do what’s best for the team.”

Kris Dunn on Jim Boylen, Oct 17, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Tomas Satoransky on Jim Boylen
item.description:
KC Johnson:Tomas Satoransky on Jim Boylen's practice demeanor:

“It’s a lot of energy. He runs up and down talking to each player. I love this type of communication when the coach is with you. I feel also that you can talk to him at anytime. And that’s the most important for the player.”

Tomas Satoransky on Jim Boylen, Oct 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Jim Boylen
item.description:
LaVine on offer to pay Boylen's fines:

“I didn’t feel like he deserved it. So I wanted to stick up for him. He sticks up for us a lot. I feel like he hasn’t got enough credit for that. We’re not winning and he’s still coaching us hard. We’re going somewhere. I appreciate that.”

Zach LaVine on Jim Boylen, Mar 17, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Jim Boylen
item.description:
KC Johnson:Jimmy Butler on Jim Boylen:

“Jim is a great coach, a great human being. I'm happy for Jim. He taught me a lot. He'll be great for the young group of guys they have here.”

Jimmy Butler on Jim Boylen, Mar 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Jabari Parker on Jim Boylen
item.description:
KC Johnson:Jabari Parker on Boylen taking him out of rotation:

“At that point, we never had controversy, always had my back. The things we had in-house problems with, I always had his back. To see that relationship go sour, not from my end but from his, was just bad because you trust a guy”

Jabari Parker on Jim Boylen, Feb 9, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Jim Boylen
item.description:
LaVine:

“It sucks sitting there and watching. You know you can help. Sometimes, you don't feel like you do anything wrong. We got blitzed to come out. Obviously, (Boylen) didn't like that. That happens in the NBA sometimes. We responded in the second quarter.”

Zach LaVine on Jim Boylen, Dec 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jim Boylen
item.description:
Sam Smith:Popovich on asst Jim Boylen leaving Spurs for Bulls:

“It was tough for him; it was like the godfather. He got an offer he couldn't refuse.”

Gregg Popovich on Jim Boylen, Nov 30, 2015. Source: Twitter @SamSmithHoops.
